posts.title: Crop Art 2026
posts.description: I had big plans for this year, but the complicated idea just didn’t come together, so here’s a simpler piece for the Crop Art competition at the Minnesota State Fair. My millet keeps falling off, no matter what glue I used. No millet next time.

posts.title: House and architectural portraits
posts.description: Got a house you love? Know someone who would love a gift of a groovy house portrait? If you’re interested in getting a rendition that looks like it showed up in the background of some classic animated tale, hit me up. I’ll ask for a few reference photos, ask if there are any specific details […]

posts.title: Portland Malt Shoppe
posts.description: A tiny little building overlooking Lake Superior that serves ice cream and malts. My daughter worked there for a few summers. Not shown: the lines of people that snake all the way out to the street most evenings.
